泡泡释放电弧，跳向附近敌人与泡泡。 持续二十秒。: Bubble releases electric arc and jumps to nearby enemies and bubbles. Lasts twenty seconds.
泥潭使人减速，踏石通道可快速穿过。: The quagmire slows down people, and the stepping stone passage can be passed quickly.
洞窟常年黑夜，随机火把提供稳定视野。照明弹可照亮全图。: The cave is always dark, and random torches provide stable vision. Flares illuminate the entire image.
洞窟每局随机布置固定火把，不会熄灭。墙和箱体会遮挡光线。: Fixed torches are randomly arranged in the cave in each game and will not go out. Walls and boxes block light.
流沙使移动变慢，中央绿洲补给更频繁。: Quicksand slows movement and central oasis supplies more frequently.
浓雾周期覆盖矿道，风会暂时吹散雾气。手持火把能扩大视野。: Thick fog periodically covers the mine tunnels, and the wind will temporarily disperse the fog. Holding a torch will expand your field of vision.
浮桥周期收起，亮起时赶快通过。: The pontoon is retracted periodically, and when it lights up, hurry through.
浮桥收起，绕行两侧！: Put the pontoon away and go around both sides!
深庭由我守护……为什么一切都变黑了？: I protect the deep court... Why has everything turned black?
深海居民被墨潮感染后的形态，可以用冰晶减慢它。: The form in which the inhabitants of the deep sea are infected by the ink tide can be slowed down with ice crystals.
清空闯关、统计与角色解锁，保留设置。原进度会自动备份。: Clears stages, stats and hero unlocks. Keeps settings and backs up your old progress.
游荡的墨潮生物。用水柱击败，注意保持退路。: Wandering ink tide creatures. Defeat them with water jets and be careful to keep your retreat route.
漩涡会吸入泡泡，周期冲击周围区域。: The vortex will suck in bubbles and periodically impact the surrounding area.
潜水钟送我们抵达海底。珊瑚居民被困在墨泡里，深庭的守护者也失去了理智。: The diving bell takes us to the bottom of the sea. The coral dwellers are trapped in the ink bubble, and the guardians of the Deep Court have lost their minds.
潮汐核心归位，群岛停止下沉。树王、蟹将和邮差点亮了归航的路。谢谢你，泡泡勇士！: The tidal core returns to its original position and the islands stop sinking. The Tree King, Crab King and Postman light up the way home. Thank you, Bubble Warrior!
激光预警！离开亮起的横线。: Laser warning! Move away from the lit horizontal line.
火把点燃：自身视野扩大二十秒！: Light the torch: Expand your field of vision for twenty seconds!
灯塔周期熄灭；仍能看见自己的位置与危险标记。: The lighthouse goes out periodically; you can still see your position and danger markers.
灯塔熄灭！留心危险标记。: The lighthouse goes out! Watch for danger signs.
灯塔能削弱墨潮。把四座塔一起点亮！: The lighthouse can weaken the ink tide. Light up the four towers together!
灯柱投影出能源车路线，遗迹的大门正在打开。: The lamppost projects the route of the energy vehicle, and the gate to the ruins is opening.
灯芯送达！王城熄灭的灯塔终于有了希望。: Wick delivered! The extinguished lighthouse of the royal city finally has hope.
炮台交替瞄准横行与纵列，亮线为射击预警。: The turret aims horizontally and vertically alternately, and the bright lines are firing warnings.
炸箱子或抢中央补给。: Blast the boxes or grab the central supply.
点亮三座古代灯柱。完成后前往中央发光的出口。: Light up three ancient lampposts. Once done, head to the central glowing exit.
点亮四座王城灯塔: Light up the four royal city lighthouses
点亮四座王城灯塔。完成后前往中央发光的出口。: Light up the four royal city lighthouses. Once done, head to the central glowing exit.
点亮四座风帆信标。完成后前往中央发光的出口。: Light up the four sail beacons. Once done, head to the central glowing exit.
点击角色可打开人物选择；左右键调整。: Click the character to choose; use left/right to adjust.
照明弹升空：全图照亮八秒！: Flares take off: The whole picture is illuminated for eight seconds!
熔岩先闪烁再喷发，避开红色裂缝。: The lava flashes and then erupts, avoiding the red cracks.
王城守卫，用烈焰强化伤害或诱饵转移注意。: Guard the royal city, use flames to enhance damage or use bait to divert attention.
王座反射爆炸回声，离开原水柱后仍要留心二次冲击。: The throne reflects the echo of the explosion, so be careful of the secondary impact after leaving the original water column.

电脑对手造型随关卡变化: AI rivals change with each stage
石碑正在读取核心的坐标。给它一点时间！: The stele is reading the coordinates of the core. Give it some time!
砂钟守卫关闭战斗模式，打开通往海底的潜水钟。: The Sand Bell Guard turns off combat mode and opens the diving bell leading to the bottom of the sea.
磁场会把泡泡拉向中央，改变爆炸位置。: The magnetic field will pull the bubble toward the center, changing the location of the explosion.
空港的巡逻机械，利用雷鸣核心扩大命中范围。: The airport's patrol machinery uses thunder cores to expand its hit range.

第一章守护者，孢子十字攻击；半血后攻击加快。: Chapter 1 Guardian, spore cross attack; attack speeds up after half health.
第三章守护者，攻击环形区域；利用间隙移动。: Chapter 3 Guardian, attack the ring area; use gaps to move.
第二章守护者，攻击整行与整列；提前离开警示带。: Chapter 2 Guardian, attack the entire row and column; leave the warning zone in advance.
第五章守护者，释放多方向冲击；注意连锁与回声。: Chapter 5 Guardian, releases multi-directional impact; pay attention to chains and echoes.
第四章守护者，瞄准角色所在区域；保持移动。: Chapter 4 Guardian, aim at the area where the character is; keep moving.
罗盘拼回原样，但居民们的求救声仍在回响。: The compass was put back together, but the residents' cries for help still echoed.
罗盘碎了，但沼泽里的种子还有光。先把三枚种子找齐。: The compass is broken, but the seeds in the swamp still have light. First find all three seeds.
罗盘被拆成四片。那是我们通往海面的路。: The compass was broken into four pieces. That's our way to the sea.
能源车成功抵达，石碑的读取装置已经恢复供电。: The energy vehicle arrived successfully, and the power supply to the stele's reading device has been restored.
能源车走得慢。请跟在它附近，清掉前路的箱子。: Energy vehicles move slowly. Please follow it and clear the boxes in front of it.
自动保存闯关进度、任务成就、角色解锁与设置。: Stage progress, achievements, heroes and settings save automatically.
至少保留一名真人。: Keep at least one human player.
获救居民送来潜水补给，告诉你孵化场的入口。: The rescued residents sent diving supplies and told you the entrance to the hatchery.
营地安全了。所有萤灯都在为你照亮王庭。: The camp is safe. All the fluorescent lights are lighting up the royal court for you.
藏宝城收集五枚即可获胜。: Collect five pieces in Treasure City to win.
藤蔓每十八秒长回，留心通道变化。: The vines grow back every eighteen seconds, so pay attention to the changes in the passage.
蝙蝠飞过钟乳石洞厅。爆炸留下回声，火把和照明弹帮助观察退路。: Bats fly through the stalactite cave hall. Explosions left echoes, and torches and flares helped spot escape routes.
蟹将清醒了。它举起钳子，把我们送回风帆空港。: The crab will wake up. It lifted its pincers and carried us back to the sailing port.
街区停电了。我们还被困在墨泡里，请带我们出去！: There is a power outage in the neighborhood. We are still trapped in the ink bubble, please take us out!
补给完成，运输车继续前进。: The supply is completed and the transport vehicle continues to move forward.
被困后使用，立即脱困。: Use it after being trapped to get out immediately.
观察攻击预警；半血后守护者会加快攻击。: Observe the attack warning; the guardian will speed up the attack after half health.
观测台保住了，飞艇开始降落，暴露了它的弱点。: The observatory was saved and the airship began to land, exposing its weakness.
警报：航线已被墨潮接管。所有来客均视为敌人。: Alert: The route has been taken over by Mo Chao. All visitors are considered enemies.
警示线亮起后激光横扫整行。: After the warning line lights up, the laser sweeps across the entire line.
设置自动保存；洞窟始终为夜晚。: Settings save automatically; caves are always dark.
谁把黑墨倒进了我的根？我已经听不见森林了……: Who poured black ink into my roots? I can no longer hear the forest…
调整道具与走位，再挑战本关。章节进度已保存。: Adjust props and positioning before challenging this level again. Chapter progress saved.
跟随车辆，在三个补给站停留充能。: Follow the vehicle and stop at three supply stations to recharge.
踏上金色开关切换石门，被占据的门不会关闭。: Step on the golden switch to switch the stone door. The occupied door will not close.
踩到蘑菇向前弹两格，可越过一格木箱。: Step on the mushroom and bounce forward two spaces to cross one wooden box.
轮箱可以推动；加固箱两点耐久，宝库箱八点耐久、丰厚掉落。水柱困住角色三秒，队友触: The wheel box can be pushed; the reinforced box has two points of durability, and the treasure chest has eight points of durability and can be dropped generously. The water column traps the character for three seconds, and teammates can rescue him by touching him. Props are picked up automatically when you walk by them, and your growth is reset every game.
轮箱可以推动；加固箱两点耐久，宝库箱八点耐久、丰厚掉落。水柱困住角色八秒，队友触: Push wheeled crates. Reinforced crates take 2 hits; vault crates take 8 and offer rich rewards. Water traps last 8 seconds. Allies rescue on contact. Walk over items to collect them. Upgrades reset each round.
轮箱可以推动；加固箱两点耐久，宝库箱八点耐久。空手自动拾取；手持主动道具时按 E: Push wheeled crates; reinforced crates take two hits, vaults eight. Empty hands pick up automatically; E / . / ; / V swaps held items. Blue plus signs mark upgrades, which reset each round.
进度已重置，原进度已备份。: Progress reset. Previous progress backed up.
选择玩法后进入专属大厅，再配置关卡、地图与队伍。: Choose a mode, then set stages, maps and teams in its lobby.
选择语言后立即生效，自动保存。: It takes effect immediately after selecting the language and saves automatically.
遗迹里的甲虫，移动通道较窄时可用泡泡封路。: Beetles in ruins can use bubbles to seal the path when their moving passage is narrow.
金箱藏有星币，先收集五枚也能赢下本局。: There are star coins hidden in the gold box. You can win this game by collecting five first.
闯入者，禁止接近潮汐档案。防卫系统启动。: Intruders are prohibited from approaching the Tidal Archives. The defense system is activated.
队友可触碰救援；同队水柱不伤队友。: Touch trapped allies to rescue them. Allied splashes are safe.
队员保持在三格内护送，在沿途补给站靠近充能。车上的耐久条耗尽会失败。: Keep the team members escorted within three spaces, and stay close to the supply stations along the way to recharge. The vehicle will fail if its durability bar is depleted.
陨星落点提前标记，爆炸覆盖周围九格。: The impact point of the meteorite is marked in advance, and the explosion covers the surrounding nine grids.
雷电会瞄准角色，警示出现后及时离开。: Thunder and lightning will target the character, and leave as soon as the warning appears.
雾气随机覆盖地图区域，每分钟有一段风吹散雾的时间。火把扩大附近视野，照明弹可照亮: Fog randomly covers areas of the map, and there is a period of time every minute for the wind to disperse the fog. Torches expand nearby vision, and flares illuminate the entire map.
靠近居民并停留一秒完成救援。: Approach the resident and stay for one second to complete the rescue.
靠近拾取获得护盾与保护，可在战斗间隙补充防护。: Pick it up close to gain shield and protection, which can be used to replenish protection between battles.
靠近笼子并停留一秒，解开牢笼。居民获救后会站起挥手。: Approach the cage and stay for one second to unlock it. Residents would stand up and wave after being rescued.
靠近队友可救援。真人倒下后可复苏两次。: Get close to teammates to rescue. A real person can be revived twice after falling down.
音乐与音效分别调整，设置自动保存。: Music and effects have separate volume. Settings save automatically.
风垫赋予两秒疾跑，掌握喷口路线。: The wind cushion gives you two seconds of sprinting to control the route of the spout.
飞艇在头顶盘旋。守住观测台，等待风帆回到港口。: Airships hovered overhead. Hold the observation deck and wait for the sail to return to port.
飞艇摆脱控制，打开王城航道。核心就在墨潮大王手中。: The airship got rid of control and opened the royal city channel. The core is in the hands of King Mo Chao.
骑术升级，提升坐骑速度与耐久。: Upgrade your riding skills to increase the speed and durability of your mount.
，原道具留在地上。: , the original props remain on the ground.
随机：每局从可选角色中抽取。: Random: choose an available character each round.
邪魔面具：中毒，操作反向二十秒！: Demon Mask: reversed controls for 20 seconds!
邪魔面具：三维全部拉满！: Demon Mask: all three stats maximized!
队友可触碰救援；所有水柱都有友伤。: Touch allies to rescue them; water jets also hit teammates.
漩涡每六秒预警并吸引周围三格的泡泡，每次只拉动一格。: Every six seconds, a warning precedes a one-cell pull of bubbles within three cells.
接触笼子即可解开牢笼。居民获救后会站起挥手。: Touch the cage to free its resident, who stands and waves.
稀有成长：水柱覆盖整行与整列，仍被墙和箱子阻挡。死亡后全部掉出。: Rare: maximize horizontal and vertical jet range; obstacles still block it. Drops on death.
拾取即生效：50% 中毒，操作反向二十秒；50% 泡泡数量、速度、纵横水柱全部拉: 50%: reversed controls for 20 seconds. 50%: six bubbles, maximum speed and full-length jets. Drops on death.

不可摧毁，四向可进入。己方保留淡轮廓，敌方无法追踪；水柱仍可进入。: Indestructible, four entrances. Allies retain faint silhouettes; enemies cannot track occupants. Water jets enter.
不可摧毁，仅沿两个开口进出；侧壁挡住人物、泡泡与水柱。: Indestructible. Enter through either open end; solid sides block actors, bubbles and water jets.
森林与沼泽的双向藏身处，开口可通行，树干侧壁挡住人物与水柱。: A two-ended forest/swamp hideout. Open ends admit passage; sides block actors and water jets.
主题藏身建筑，四向出入；不会挡住水柱，不能靠藏身免疫伤害。: A themed shelter with four entrances. Water jets enter; hiding grants no damage immunity.
营地藏身处，四向出入；己方保留淡轮廓，水柱可进入。: Camp hideout with four entrances. Allies retain faint silhouettes; water jets enter.
驾驶赛车依次通过检查点，完成三圈。: Drive through checkpoints in order and complete three laps.
弯道提前减速，避免冲出赛车路线。: Slow down before corners to stay on the racing line.
利用惯性过弯，争夺固定赛车补给。: Use momentum through bends and claim kart supply stations.
拾取后驾驶，缓慢起速、持续加速；驾驶通过赛车检查点才有效。: Pick up to drive. Accelerate gradually; checkpoints count only while driving.
驾驶赛车依次通过检查点，默认三圈，按冲线顺序为个人或队伍计分。: Drive through checkpoints in order. Three laps by default; finish order awards individual or team points.
二至八个席位自由分成最多八队，每人一队即混战，先赢两局夺冠。: Split 2–8 seats into up to eight teams, or one team per player for free-for-all. First to two wins.
至少需要两支有玩家的队伍。: At least two occupied teams are required.
速度固定二级，一格耐久；已有坐骑时重复拾取不会替换，死亡全部掉落。: Fixed speed level 2 and 1 durability. Extra mounts are stored without replacing the current mount; all drop on death.
速度固定最低级，两格耐久，可承受两次水柱。: Fixed lowest speed and 2 durability; withstands two water blasts.
速度固定最高级，一格耐久；可跳过单格障碍，跑八格后休息一秒，蓝条显示耐力。: Fixed highest speed and 1 durability. Jumps over single-tile obstacles; rests for one second after eight tiles. Blue bar shows stamina.
骑术最多三级，拾取时修复当前坐骑一点耐久，不改变固定速度和血量上限。: Up to three riding levels. Each pickup repairs one durability on your current mount without changing its fixed speed or maximum durability.
